cases.suffix: RETURN {var}.arr IS NULL AS a, {var}.obj IS NULL AS o ORDER BY {var}.id ASC
RETURN COALESCE({var}.arr,NULL) AS arr, COALESCE({var}.obj,NULL) AS obj ORDER BY {var}.id ASC
RETURN COUNT({var}.arr) AS direct, COUNT(COALESCE({var}.arr,NULL)) AS indirect, COUNT(COALESCE({var}.obj,NULL)) AS objects
RETURN COUNT(COALESCE({var},NULL)) AS entities, SUM({var}) AS total
RETURN {var} IS NULL AS absent ORDER BY {var}.id ASC
RETURN {var}.marker AS id ORDER BY id DESC

edge_cases.query: MATCH (a)-[e:rel]->(b) WHERE e.weight > 1 RETURN e IS NULL AS absent, e.label AS label, e.metadata AS metadata
OPTIONAL MATCH (a {x:1})-[e:rel]->(b) RETURN a.id AS id, e IS NULL AS absent, e.weight AS weight ORDER BY id ASC
OPTIONAL MATCH (a {x:1})-[e:rel]->(b) WHERE e.weight > 3 RETURN a.id AS id, e IS NULL AS absent ORDER BY id ASC
MATCH (a)<-[e:rel]-(b) WHERE e.weight > 1 RETURN a.id AS left, b.id AS right
MATCH ()-[e:rel]->() WHERE e.weight > 1 RETURN e.source AS source, e.target AS target
